posts.text:
Our national debt surpassed $40 trillion, yet very few in Washington are worried about addressing this crisis.

I put forth the Six Penny Plan to make even, across-the-board cuts so we can balance our budget in five years. All it takes is cutting six cents from every $1 the federal government spends.
